cards.text: The wall around Jerusalem is UP, friend. Nehemiah, who rallied the people to rebuild it (Nehemiah 2:17-18), is telling us what comes next in his own words. He's got one more thing to put in place.

cards.question: With Jerusalem's wall rebuilt, what does Nehemiah set in place?
With the doors set in place, the ___ are appointed, along with the singers and the Levites.

cards.text: Next, somebody has to run Jerusalem. Nehemiah puts his brother Hanani in charge, along with Hananiah, the commander of the fortress.

cards.question: Nehemiah gives a reason for one of his picks to run Jerusalem. What does he say about that man?

answers.text: He was faithful and feared God more than most
He had fought off the enemies at the wall
He knew every family living in the city

cards.text: Then Nehemiah gives Hanani and Hananiah their orders for the gates. When it comes to this city, the man is taking ZERO chances.

cards.question: Nehemiah tells Hanani and Hananiah to open the gates of Jerusalem at first light, as early as they can.

cards.text: Nehemiah says no opening the gates until the sun is hot, so Jerusalem's gates just got a SNOOZE button. And while the guards are on duty, he wants the doors kept shut and securely fastened.

cards.question: Somebody has to keep watch over Jerusalem. Who does Nehemiah want appointed as the guards?

answers.text: Soldiers sent by the king of Persia

cards.text: Now step back and take a look at Jerusalem. The city is large and spacious, all wrapped up in that rebuilt wall.

cards.question: Jerusalem is large and spacious, with ___ people living in it.
Inside Jerusalem's rebuilt wall, the houses still haven't been rebuilt.

cards.text: Then Nehemiah says his God put something into his heart, and it's a BIG gathering.

cards.question: God puts it into Nehemiah's heart to gather the nobles, the officials and the people, so they can be enrolled by ___.

cards.text: Then Nehemiah FINDS something written down. Friend, I spent years in a junk drawer watching people dig for one piece of paper, and I never saw ANYBODY find it.

cards.question: Right when Nehemiah wants the people enrolled by genealogy, what does he find?

answers.text: The register of those who first returned
A letter from the king of Persia
The scroll of the Law of Moses

cards.text: That register lists the people who came back from captivity in Babylon to Jerusalem and Judah, counted family by family and town by town. Some priests search for their family records and can't find them, so they're excluded from the priesthood as unclean, and the governor tells them not to eat the most holy things until there's a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim. The whole assembly comes to 42,360, and that's not a moving day, friend, that's a whole TOWN on the road. Then the governor, some of the family heads and the rest of the people give gold, silver and priestly garments to the treasury for the project.

cards.question: In the end, all the Israelites move inside Jerusalem's walls to live.

cards.text: The priests, Levites, gatekeepers, singers, temple servants and the rest of the Israelites settle in their own towns, and by the seventh month they're settled. We'll stop here for now, friend, but this story is NOT done.
